text: I am Angar, one of the real guards of the outpost. We were overrun about a week ago by a draconian army. I was coming in from a patrol when I saw them taking over. They were everywhere ...\nHe slumps down on the bed. You notice that he desperately needs food and rest, but he waves off your help and continues his story,\n"I hid and they missed me, but they captured most of the other guards. They are being held in the outpost jail. Also, they're guarding the north side of town heavily. I think they might have hostages there too."
note: 跨欄（第 1 欄到第 2 欄）。行尾連字號已併字：captured。"everywhere ..." 省略號前有空格。"continues his story," 結尾為逗號（原印刷）

text: Just before the Temple of Duerghast was closed, dead bodies were seen being carried into the arena in the Temple's northwest corner. There were hundreds of them. It has been discovered that the Death Knight, Sir Lebaum, has taken over the Temple and has gathered together the exhumed dead for miles around.\nThere is no way that you can get into the temple through the front gates. You must get the Shadowpeople's support. They have tunnels that cross from the Temple of Huerzyd to the Temple of Duerghast." She pulls out an amulet. "This amulet will let you through a secret door. The Shadowpeople will find you once you enter Huerzyd."
